sessionStart.command: /bin/sh -c 'f="$HOME/bin/ctxtra"; if [ -x "$f" ]; then exec "$f" hook copilot sessionStart; else /bin/cat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "{}"; fi'

subagentStart.command: /bin/sh -c 'f="$HOME/bin/ctxtra"; if [ -x "$f" ]; then exec "$f" hook copilot subagentStart; else /bin/cat >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "{}"; fi'
